## Modifications

definitions retain the selected semantics, construction and register with
markup removed. English and Chinese are new scoped explanatory translations

and surrounded by slashes; no liaison, audio or image is copied.

lock-key definition. `clef` itself supplies pronunciation. The frozen identity
remains `clef/NOM`; no runtime alias is admitted. Inflected counterparts remain
grammatical evidence only. The exact lowercase `indien/NOM` drink remains
distinct from the adjective and capitalized demonyms.

# D2 #129 author package

This package proposes **50 exact groups, 50 selected senses and 200 fields**
for frozen rows **2401–2450** in [ticket #129](https://github.com/zardonc/lexique/issues/129).
Every selected sense has a French definition, applicable IPA, English meaning
and Chinese meaning for the same POS and use. The 47 distinct ticket headwords
use **48 fixed French articles**, including the separately captured `clé`
spelling target for `clef`. Complete contributor pagination retains **8 API
responses, 3,153 named article-contributor memberships and 487 anonymous
article-contributor counts**. These are article credits, not distinct people
across the batch or proof of a selected sentence's individual author.

[Groups](groups.json) contain the complete candidate content.
[Field review](field-review.json) contains 200 pending field records with fixed
sources and grammatical evidence. [Admission](admission.json) preserves the
**4,087-group** denominator. [Reuse](reuse.json) compares the exact groups with
the admitted `core-119-v1` input: **0 reused groups and 0 reused fields**.
No annotation exception, specialist exception or runtime alias is proposed.

## Evidence

- [Sources](sources.json): fixed revisions, timestamps, article/history links,
  applicable attribution, licences and original-work layers.
- [Captures](source-captures.json): retained API responses and raw wikitext,
  complete contributor pagination, preparation and selection paths.
- [Source excerpts](source-excerpts.json): all 200 exact field spans and
  French language, POS, spelling, inflection and construction evidence.
- [Source context](source-context.json): full named contributor registries,
  anonymous counts, import/reference boundaries and 50 spelling bindings.
- [Rights](rights.json), [selected rights](selected-rights.md),
  [notices](NOTICES.md) and [legal text](COPYING): the proposed redistribution
  route, field-level modifications and separately credited original works.
- [Selected-use notes](source-research.md): everyday meanings and restrictions
  requiring independent semantic and construction review.

The fields contain **10,730 Unicode characters** in total; the longest field
contains **173 characters**. These are candidate-text measurements, not native
response, SQLite, lookup-performance or packaged-size measurements.

## Author verification

Approved seam: the candidate resource/admission record, against the immutable
ticket membership and retained fixed source bytes. The focused checks detect
missing groups/fields or selected-use labels, altered membership, wrong field languages,
incomplete contributor pagination, divergent raw captures and unsupported
independent-acceptance claims. The replay check detects preparation drift.

# Selected-span rights proposal for #129

All 200 candidate fields have fixed revision/line bindings, complete retained
article contributor attribution, modification information and a source-specific
rights proposal in [rights.json](rights.json). Independent rights acceptance is
zero. The combined redistributable resource is assessed by the parent after
independent selected-span review.

## Contribution and adaptation layers

The retained Wiktionnaire copyright convention fixes its text licence as
CC BY-SA 4.0. Wikimedia Terms of Use section 7 provides article/history-link
attribution and requires imported content's separate terms to remain applicable.
The exact [authority captures](../../../target/issue-129/rights-authorities.json)
reuse existing successful policy/API/HTML captures with their actual timestamps,
fixed policy revisions and original capture location retained.

CC BY-SA 4.0 sections 2(a)(1), 2(a)(4), 3(a), 3(b) and 4 permit sharing and
adaptation, including commercial use, with attribution, licence identification,
modification notices, ShareAlike and no additional restrictions. Its public-domain
boundary does not relicense the separate original works. The [complete legal
text](COPYING), [notices](NOTICES.md), article/history links and field-level
modification records accompany the candidate package.

French fields are scoped adaptations of the selected French lexical semantics.
English and Chinese are new explanatory translations by Lexique contributors
under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 adaptation route. IPA selects a recorded variant and
adds slashes; it does not import recordings or images. All spelling relations
serve source binding only; no runtime alias or changed frozen membership enters
this proposal.

## Imported original works

**Académie française:** thirty captured articles declare DAF8 imports.
The original collective eighth-edition dictionary was published in 1932–1935.
The established [original-work evidence](../issue-99/source-context.json) applies
Code de la propriété intellectuelle article L123-3: seventy years from 1 January
following publication of a collective work. Using the final 1935 publication
conservatively gives 1966-01-01. This proposal credits Académie française where
the original work contributes; current Wiktionnaire transcription/adaptation and
the new Lexique adaptation retain their own CC BY-SA 4.0 layer.

**Émile Littré:** `passager` declares both Littré and DAF8 imports. The package
reuses the separately established [Littré original-work evidence](../issue-120/source-context.json)
for Émile Littré (1801–1881), *Dictionnaire de la langue française*, 1872–1877.
The recorded L123-1 lifetime-plus-seventy-year basis conservatively expires on
1952-01-01, with the BnF author/edition authority retained. No modern XMLittré,
ARTFL or other external transcription is copied. The selected nominal transport
sense at line 92 and nominal IPA at line 87 remain bound to the actual fixed
Wiktionnaire revision, with both declared original layers credited.

An article-level import marker says all or part came from an original work and
may have changed; it does not locate that original wording at a particular
selected sentence. The proposal supplies the permitted original-work routes
alongside the fixed contributor/adaptation route; the independent reviewer
still assesses each actual selected/imported boundary.

## Redistribution scope

Selected learner fields contain lexical definitions, isolated IPA and scoped
translations only. Literary/news/social-media quotations, lyrics, media,
etymologies and referenced external dictionary prose are excluded. Construction
support selects short French grammatical fragments at exact columns rather
than the surrounding example sentences.

The parent-produced resource must retain actual fixed-source/version material,
full contributor/history credits, separate original-work attributions, complete
applicable legal text and modification notices, and distribute adaptation text
under CC BY-SA 4.0 without additional restrictions. The project source-code MIT
licence does not replace these content terms. Contributor pagination proves
the retained attribution registry, not independent quality or selected-sentence
authorship. Final combined notices and source obligations remain pending.

# Selected uses for #129

One selected sense per exact frozen group supplies 200 proposed fields.
[Groups](groups.json) and [field review](field-review.json) retain the full
FR/IPA/EN/ZH wording, exclusions and fixed line bindings. English and Chinese
are new scoped explanations of the selected French use, licensed as adaptations
under CC BY-SA 4.0, rather than imports from unverified translation tables.

The French language and exact lexical POS headings accompany each definition.
Pronunciation comes from the same French POS frame, including nominal `manque`
at its `fr-rég` line. No verb-form IPA is substituted for a noun or interjection.
`indien`, `communiste` and `chrétien` retain separate noun and adjective senses.

## Selected restrictions

| Frozen row | Exact group | Scope and boundary |
| ---: | --- | --- |

## Source boundaries

The selected dictionary meanings use French lexical definitions and recorded
phonetic/grammatical contributions. Neighbouring literary/news/social-media
examples, lyrics, media, external linked dictionary prose and other-language
content supply no imported learner fields. Short construction spans have exact
columns; their surrounding raw source stays in the ignored evidence archive.

`indien`'s cited song lyric is context only; no lyric is copied into the drink
definition. Orangina names an ingredient without importing logos or advertising.
The `clef` photographs and `ha` illustration are likewise excluded.

Thirty source articles retain DAF8 import markers. `passager` additionally
declares an import from Littré. The [selected rights](selected-rights.md) and
per-field [rights records](rights.json) distinguish those original works from
the Wiktionnaire and Lexique contribution/adaptation layers. Source reference
lists or import markers do not identify a selected sentence's individual author.

Independent semantic, rights, pronunciation, spelling and construction review
remains pending for all 200 fields.
